instruction: Open the .xcf file from the Desktop using GIMP, then export it as a PNG file named 'exported_image.png' to the Desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task requires opening XCF in GIMP and exporting as PNG. Evaluator checks if the exported PNG exists on Desktop and structurally matches the original XCF content.

llm_judge_reasons: Source XCF file path is provided in expected.rules.source_xcf but never used in metric logic
Metric uses hardcoded dimensions (1152x648) instead of reading actual XCF dimensions
Function name suggests 'structure_sim' and imports SSIM, but no structural similarity comparison is performed
Evaluator only verifies that A PNG with specific dimensions exists, not that the specific XCF was exported correctly
Cannot verify the PNG content actually matches the XCF content - would pass even if user exported a different file with same dimensions
Brittle logic: would fail if source XCF has different dimensions even if export was done correctly
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Read the source XCF file dimensions from expected.rules.source_xcf instead of hardcoding
Perform actual structural similarity comparison between XCF and PNG content using SSIM
Add logic to verify the PNG content visually matches the XCF (e.g., render XCF layers and compare with PNG)
Consider checking file metadata or timestamps to verify the PNG was recently created from the XCF
Remove misleading function name or implement the promised structural similarity check
